description: Delete a voice memo: its audio file moves to the Trash and its database row is removed. Fails unless confirm=true, and refuses while the Voice Memos app is running. Pass dryRun=true (with confirm=false) to see which recording an id names without changing anything.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete. The audio is recoverable from the Trash; the recording's entry is not.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

dryRun.description: Report the recording that would be deleted and change nothing.

id.description: Memo ID from memos_list, or an unambiguous prefix of it.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.

title: memos_delete: arguments
